description: Identify what a file really is from its bytes (not its name): 80+ signatures (images, audio, video, archives, PDF / Office / OpenDocument / EPUB, executables ELF / PE / Mach-O / WASM, fonts, SQLite / Parquet / pcap, ML model files GGUF / safetensors / PyTorch / pickle), container sniffing (DOCX vs XLSX vs JAR vs APK, tar.gz, MP4 vs HEIC vs AVIF, WebP / WAV / AVI), text sniffing (JSON, XML, SVG, HTML, CSV, PEM, scripts) and image dimensions. Flags risky content (executables, macros, pickles, shortcuts) and mismatches with the declared file name or MIME type. Base64 input (up to ~140 KB) or a URL (first 64 KB, SSRF-safe). Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/file-type-detect

data.description: File content, base64 (standard or URL-safe; data: URI accepted)

filename.description: Declared file name, checked against the content

mimeType.description: Declared MIME type, checked against the content

url.description: Public URL (only the first 64 KB is read)
